crate_edition: workspace inherited for all five touched crates
original_cargo_root_body:
[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
    "crates/cc-model",
    "crates/cc-db",
    "crates/cc-parsers",
    "crates/cc-index",
    "crates/cc-search",
    "crates/cc-server",
    "crates/cc-eval",
    "crates/cc-semantic",
]

[workspace.package]
version = "1.0.0"
edition = "2021"
# MSRV 1.95: rusqlite 0.40 / libsqlite3-sys 0.38 use `cfg_select!` (stabilized in 1.95).
rust-version = "1.95"
license = "MIT"

[workspace.dependencies]
# Serialization
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1", features = ["float_roundtrip"] }

# Error handling
thiserror = "2"

# SQLite
rusqlite = { version = "0.40", features = ["bundled", "vtab", "functions"] }
r2d2 = "0.8"
r2d2_sqlite = "0.35"

# Hashing
blake3 = "1"

# CLI
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }

# Directories
dirs = "5"

# Async
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }

# Parallelism
rayon = "1"

# File watching
notify = "8.2"

# File scanning (gitignore-aware)
ignore = "0.4"

# Tree-sitter
tree-sitter = "0.24"
tree-sitter-python = "0.23"
tree-sitter-javascript = "0.23"
tree-sitter-typescript = "0.23"
tree-sitter-rust = "0.23"
tree-sitter-go = "0.23"
tree-sitter-java = "0.23"
tree-sitter-c = "0.23"
tree-sitter-cpp = "0.23"

# Logging
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }

# Regex
regex = "1"

# LRU cache
lru = "0.18.2"

# Time
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }
libc = "0.2"

# MCP
rmcp = { version = "2.2", features = ["server", "transport-io"] }

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
strip = true
formatting_config: Explicit empty owned TOML preserves repository default settings and prevents unrelated runner home configuration. --edition 2021 matches the original workspace. No skip_children or other unstable option is set.

module_rule.reason: Formatting text input avoids resolving out-of-line modules not present in the fixed candidate subset.
module_rule.source_reference: rust-lang/rustfmt src/modules.rs: visit_crate skips visiting submodules when input is stdin; actual 1.95 tool identity/version and command output will be recorded during execution.

limitations: This is a configuration/source observation, not Rust parsing, compilation or semantic execution.
Final normal repository CI remains required after formatted candidate bytes are reviewed and installed.
